findings.title: Agent paused mid-reply for 2.21s, then resumed
findings.summary: A 0.18s burst of user voice activity paused the agent's reply. No transcript followed, so the agent resumed after 2.21s.

evidence.label: Agent reply that was paused
evidence.value: Yes, that works perfectly. I'll take the Tuesday at 8 AM.

root_cause.statement: Possible acoustic echo: the microphone may have picked up the agent's own voice shortly after it started speaking.
missing_evidence: Microphone audio at the trigger time (voice, noise, or echo?)
A repeat of the same script with headphones

next_steps: Listen to the microphone channel around the trigger time.
Re-run the same script with headphones and compare false-interruption counts.
Consider lowering false_interruption_timeout to shorten the audible gap.

findings.title: One-word transcript 'Hi,' cut off the agent and changed its reply
findings.summary: The agent was interrupted by a very short user transcript, then answered it as if the caller had gone silent.

evidence.label: Agent's next reply
evidence.value: Hello? Are you still there? Is there anything else available on Tuesday or Thursday morning?

root_cause.statement: Speech-to-text may have transcribed a brief sound as a word. The data can't tell whether the tester actually said it.

next_steps: Listen to the microphone channel for this turn.
Check whether a minimum interruption word count would have prevented the cut-off.
